responseText:
Just as a seasoned mariner must read the currents, an alchemist must learn the name and spirit within each flower and stone.

Grind some ruby powder, and purchase a bit of honeycomb from the alchemy vendor. 
Combine these into a potent philter of health.

Bring it to me when you've finished, to test the purity.
